culpritSource.quote: The true culprit is Aoi Inukai. She rented a room next to Kohei Miki's and hypnotized him with a planetarium projector to vandalize Kaneko's Jewelry Store in the hopes he robs it. However, Miki was caught by Kogoro by chance, so she ended up having to sneak in the Jewelry Store on her own, only to be caught by Takagi, Chiba and the Detective Boys when she was surprised with her own projector.

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are filming a movie in which Ayumi will write its process into her illustrated diary with the help of Kogoro, the topic of the movie is the case in which Kogoro had captured the graffiti vandaliser. It’s kinda hard to believe that a group of 7-year-old kids can actually make use of editing tools and CG-tech to make the product more convincing, to the point in which it can help win a prize for them and give ideas for Ayumi besides being just a class report.
